name: Executive VIP Transfer Service
author: Gksoft Dev Team

sections.description:
Executive VIP Transfer Service is a complete booking solution for chauffeur companies, airport transfer businesses, limousine services, private drivers, and executive transportation providers.

It provides a modern three-step booking experience where customers can:

  1. Select pickup and drop-off locations
  2. Review available vehicles and route-based prices
  3. Enter passenger details and complete payment

The plugin integrates with Google Maps services for address autocomplete, distance calculation, route information, and travel duration. Bookings are processed through WooCommerce, giving site owners access to established payment gateways, order management, and customer notifications.

WooCommerce is required.

View the live booking experience

Key Features

  • Modern three-step transfer booking form
  • Google Places address autocomplete
  • Pickup and drop-off route calculation
  • Distance and estimated travel duration
  • Distance-based pricing
  • Minimum service price and maximum distance controls
  • Passenger and luggage capacity validation
  • One-way and return journey support
  • Pickup date and time scheduling
  • Minimum advance booking time rules
  • Responsive vehicle selection cards
  • Live booking summary and price updates
  • Card and manual/cash payment options
  • WooCommerce order and payment integration
  • Booking confirmation and tracking workflow
  • Responsive layout for desktop, tablet, and mobile
  • Theme-independent front-end styling
  • Modern plugin settings, reservations, and vehicle management screens

Vehicle Management

Create and manage a professional fleet directly from WordPress:

  • Vehicle name, image, and description
  • Passenger and luggage capacity
  • Distance-based vehicle pricing
  • Vehicle features and service badges
  • Active and inactive vehicle status
  • Automatic availability filtering by passenger and luggage requirements
  • Route-based price preview before vehicle selection

Booking Experience

The booking form is designed to keep the reservation process clear and focused:

  • Step 1 — Route: Pickup, drop-off, date, time, passengers, luggage, return journey, map, distance, and duration
  • Step 2 — Vehicle: Vehicle images, capacity, features, route-based pricing, and selection
  • Step 3 — Details & Payment: Passenger contact details, flight information, special requests, payment method, and final booking summary

The optional booking header can be enabled globally from the plugin settings or for an individual shortcode.

Admin Dashboard

The plugin includes dedicated admin screens for:

  • General booking configuration
  • Google Maps API settings
  • Currency and pricing rules
  • Booking form options
  • Payment methods
  • Email notifications
  • Vehicle management
  • Reservation management
  • Reservation status and payment review

Free and Pro

The free version provides the core transfer booking workflow, Google-powered address selection, global distance-based pricing, WooCommerce integration, and booking management.

The Pro version adds advanced business features such as:

  • Vehicle management
  • Vehicle-specific route pricing
  • Live route map and directions
  • Advanced pickup scheduling
  • Capacity-based vehicle filtering
  • Enhanced booking summaries
  • Priority support

Compare features and view the Pro version

Live Demo

See the complete booking flow in action:

🚀 Open Live Demo

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.6 or later
  • PHP 7.2 or later
  • WooCommerce installed and active
  • A valid Google Maps API key
  • The following Google Cloud APIs enabled:
    • Maps JavaScript API
    • Places API
    • Distance Matrix API

For better security, restrict the Google API key by HTTP referrer and configure appropriate usage limits in Google Cloud Console.

Shortcodes

Display the booking form:

[execvitr_form]

Display the booking form with the optional booking header:

[execvitr_form show_hero="yes"]

Force the booking header to remain hidden:

[execvitr_form show_hero="no"]

The plugin automatically creates the required booking and tracking pages during activation. Customers are redirected to a secure booking or payment flow after submitting the reservation form.

How It Works

For Customers

  1. Select pickup and drop-off addresses from Google suggestions.
  2. Choose the pickup date, time, passenger count, and luggage count.
  3. Review the calculated distance, duration, and starting price.
  4. Select an available vehicle.
  5. Enter passenger and optional flight information.
  6. Select a payment method and confirm the booking.
  7. Complete payment through WooCommerce when online payment is selected.

For Administrators

  1. Configure the Google API key, country restriction, currency, and pricing rules.
  2. Add vehicles with images, capacities, features, and distance rates.
  3. Configure available payment methods and notification settings.
  4. Review, edit, filter, and manage reservations from the plugin dashboard.
  5. Track payments and booking status through WooCommerce.

Privacy

The plugin sends location-related requests to Google Maps services to provide address suggestions, route distance, and estimated travel duration.

Reservation and customer information is stored and processed through WordPress and WooCommerce according to the configuration and privacy policy of the website owner.

The plugin does not include its own advertising analytics or independent visitor-tracking system.

External services:

  • Google Maps Terms of Service
  • Google Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/executive-vip-transfer-service/, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Activate Executive VIP Transfer Service.
  4. Go to VIP Transfer Service → Settings.
  5. Enter your Google Maps API key and configure pricing, currency, payment, and booking options.
  6. Add vehicles from VIP Transfer Service → Cars when vehicle management is available.
  7. Add [execvitr_form] to any page, or use the booking page created automatically by the plugin.
sections.faq:
Is WooCommerce required?

Yes. WooCommerce is used for order creation, payment processing, order status management, and supported payment gateways.

Where can I see a working example?

Open the live demo to review the complete route, vehicle, passenger, and payment flow.

Why does the displayed price differ from a Google route estimate?

Google provides route distance and duration. The final price is calculated using the pricing rules configured in the plugin, including distance rates, vehicle rates, minimum price, return journey, and configured fees.

Why is address autocomplete not working?

Confirm that your Google API key is valid, the required APIs are enabled, billing is active when required by Google, and the key is permitted for your website domain.

Can customers see a price before selecting a vehicle?

Yes. After the route is calculated, the booking summary can display the lowest available vehicle price as a starting price. The exact total is updated when a vehicle is selected.

Can I hide the large booking header?

Yes. It is disabled by default in version 1.3.8. You can control it from the plugin settings or use the show_hero shortcode attribute.

Can I accept cash payments?

Yes. Manual or cash payment can be enabled from the payment settings. Card payments can also be processed through available WooCommerce payment gateways.

Can I use miles instead of kilometers?

Yes. The plugin supports kilometer and mile-based distance display and pricing configuration.

Another plugin also loads Google Maps. Can this cause a conflict?

The plugin includes safeguards against duplicate initialization. If another theme or plugin injects Google Maps more than once on the same page, review the script-loading settings and remove the duplicate Google Maps loader.

Can I use a different currency for each country?

The current version uses one global currency configuration for the booking system.

  • Added: Automatic migration for previously saved header visibility settings.
  • Added: Per-shortcode header visibility control with show_hero="yes" and show_hero="no".

  • Added: Editable booking header badge, title, description, and benefit text.
  • Improved: Compatibility with websites that provide their own page header or hero section.

  • Improved: Input spacing and right-to-left layout compatibility.
